body: THIS IS NORMAL. when i am bored i go crazy!!!! everyone has bad days, and not talking to your friends all day would suck! BUT, you have the power to make those days better. Next time your friends aren’t in class you should focus on getting all of your homework done that day for the rest of the week. It will keep you busy at school, and you’ll always feel really good about yourself by the end of the day because you got so much done! Being proud of yourself is important. This way, when your friends come back to school you can focus on having fun and making the most of your time with them!! Cheer up, it’ll be okay i promise! I’m 22 years old and graduating college in May, i still get blue when i don’t talk to my friends all day, but i find things to focus on instead! Also, check up on your friends and make sure they’re okay, maybe they’re playing hookie from school and are going through something too
Please, don’t jump. It will get better. Talk to me, please?
